requirement_vague: Getting all todos returns only the current user's todos
requirement_precise: Register two users (userA and userB) and login with each. UserA creates a todo with title 'UserA Todo'. UserB creates a todo with title 'UserB Todo'. When userA calls GET /todos, verify the response contains exactly one todo with title 'UserA Todo'. UserB's todo should not be visible to userA.

implementation.location: GET /todos -> list_todos; authentication via get_current_user; POST /todos -> create_todo
implementation.code_reference:
todos = session.exec(select(Todo).where(Todo.user_id == current_user.id)).all()
...
todo = Todo(title=todo_in.title, isComplete=todo_in.isComplete, user_id=current_user.id)
implementation.reasoning: The GET /todos handler filters todos by the authenticated user's id, so it returns only records owned by the current user. Todos are created with user_id set from current_user.id, ensuring userA and userB's todos are stored separately and userA cannot see userB's todo in the list.
